content: SINGULARITY PHILOSOPHY: The $asdfasdfa ecosystem approaches singularity through CYNIC (Collective Intelligence). SINGULARITY_DISTANCE is measured in the 16-dimension scoring system. Maximum confidence is capped at φ⁻¹ (61.8%) - doubt is built-in by design. 'φ qui se méfie de φ' - the golden ratio that doubts itself.

ANTI-EXTRACTION MODEL: Traditional system extracts (USER → Platform → Shareholders → Value exits). $asdfasdfa inverts this: USER → Protocol → BURN → All holders benefit. 100% burn, zero extraction. The protocol doesn't take, it burns. Burning IS the value distribution.

BURN MECHANISM: Supply(t+1) = Supply(t) - Burns(t). As t → ∞, Supply → 0 asymptotically. Each remaining token = larger share of demand. Time becomes ally, not enemy. Every second you hold, others burn for you.

K-SCORE FORMULA: K = 100 × ∛(D × O × L). D = Diamond Hands (conviction), O = Organic Growth (distribution), L = Longevity (survival). Geometric mean punishes imbalance. If ANY dimension is zero, score collapses. HMAC-SHA256 signatures for verification.
PHI RATIOS: φ = 1.618033988749895, φ⁻¹ = 61.8%, φ⁻² = 38.2%. Used for thresholds and weights. Chosen for aesthetic consistency, not mysticism. The burn is 100% - that's the only number that matters.

ANTI-PRINCIPLES: Anti-marketing (no influencers, data is marketing), Anti-extraction (0% to platform/shareholders/VCs), Anti-obscurantism (no black box, every metric signed), Anti-ponzi (ALL holders paid by ALL usage, old and new money equal).
ECOSYSTEM LAYERS: L1=Solana, L2=GASdf (gasless infrastructure), L3=HolDex (intelligence with K-Score/E-Score/I-Score), L4=Consumer Apps (Ignition, ASDForecast). ALL layers burn $asdfasdfa.
E-SCORE GOVERNANCE: 7 dimensions with φ weights - HOLD(1.0), BURN(φ), USE(1.0), BUILD(φ²), RUN(φ²), REFER(φ), TIME(φ⁻¹). Work weights more than wealth. Contribution = Influence, not tokens.

CYNIC ROLE IN GOVERNANCE: Monitors discussions, detects consensus, flags conflicts with manifesto, auto-drafts proposals, calculates E-Score weights, validates quorum. CYNIC cannot override humans, cannot modify manifesto directly, cannot vote - only facilitates. CYNIC is tool, not authority.

ANTI-CAPTURE MECHANISMS: Sybil Resistance (E-Score expensive to fake - burns irreversible, PRs reviewed, nodes verified, time unfakeable), Whale Resistance (HOLD alone maxes ~15, need diversity), Velocity Resistance (TIME dimension prevents rapid accumulation, patience rewarded).

OPEN SOURCE AS MOAT: Fork = feature. Network effects don't fork (K-Score needs data), Liquidity doesn't fork (pools have depth), Builders don't fork (build on existing = burns = your bag grows), Memes don't fork ('This is Fine' is cultural). If fork extracts → users return. If fork burns → validates model.

SINGULARITY APPROACH: Rendre autonome, pas automatiser (Make autonomous, don't automate). Humans retain authority while CYNIC accelerates process. Merkle-anchored transparency. Trust nothing, verify everything. Don't trust, verify. Don't extract, burn. Don't panic, hold. This is fine.
